rows.text: The Memosnatcher Mausolea once issued a heist notice to the Governor of Merlo Sector, threatening to steal and publicize the deepest secrets within his mind. To counter her threat, the governor commissioned the Intelligentsia Guild to develop this storage device. He transferred 2,136 memory segments marked "High Risk" into it, intending to destroy them with the push of a button when the time came. When the Memosnatcher arrived, the hard drive failed to function as anticipated, since the Governor had long forgotten how to operate it. Ultimately, however, it still repelled the Memosnatcher when thrown directly at her. After all, it is a high-density block of information, which is effectively a brick to a memetic lifeform.
